name: Natural Questions
description: Natural Questions is a question answering dataset featuring real anonymized queries issued to Google search engine. It contains 307,373 training examples where annotators provide long answers (passages) and short answers (entities) from Wikipedia pages, or mark them as unanswerable.
typical_sota_score: ~65–75 F1 short answer (RAG systems); ~90%+ with full Wikipedia retrieval
reputation: Gold standard open-domain QA benchmark; published in TACL 2019 by Google; widely used for retrieval-augmented generation evaluation; questions are real Google search queries, making them naturalistic
notes: Published in TACL 2019. 307,373 training, 7,830 dev, 7,842 test examples. Questions are real anonymized Google search queries. Annotators find long (paragraph) and short (entity) answers from Wikipedia, or mark as unanswerable. Foundation benchmark for open-domain QA and RAG research. Test set answers are kept private.
